name: attic/activecells-hardware
description: The hardware synthesis back end for ActiveCells: cells and ports turned into an FPGA design rather than into code.
residual: ActiveCells -- cell, cellnet, port -- is a feature of the LANGUAGE and the compiler supports it: the parser and the semantic checker are in std/compiler and stay there. What is here is the synthesis back end, and nothing in the tree imports FoxHardware at all.
Not shipped and not tested: it cannot be used without hardware tooling we do not have, and there is no way for us to tell whether it still works.
